plan.title: Recreate Order with Past Delivery Date

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ event required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-editing configuration.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the closed bid is shown.
Use the available RFQ Settings action to open the Recreate Order window.
Assert that the Recreate Order window opened and exposes its submission control.
Set the requested event end-time duration.
Choose the past delivery date specified by the negative case.
Attempt to create the order with the invalid past Delivery Date.
Assert that Procol refuses the order creation and reports an error.
